research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Tonkean is researching systems and methods for graphical user interface based programming for automated workflows. The abstract describes a graphical user interface that lets users generate workflows by defining conditions and actions, and then execute these automated workflows. This aligns with an enterprise no code process orchestration platform, focusing on GUI driven workflow definition, condition action modeling, and automation execution as key areas of research and development.

about_short_description.short_description: Tonkean provides an enterprise no-code process orchestration platform.

product.name: Tonkean Agentic Orchestration Platform
product.description: An enterprise platform for designing, deploying, and governing AI-assisted and automated business processes across departments, people, applications, and systems.

product.name: Enterprise AI Agents
product.description: Configurable AI agents that execute enterprise tasks and coordinate multi-step workflows, including sourcing, contract management, invoice processing, policy support, and approvals.

product.name: AI Front Door
product.description: An AI-powered intake interface that interprets employee requests, gathers relevant context, routes work to the appropriate process, and can resolve routine requests.

product.name: ProcurementWorks
product.description: A procurement process orchestration solution for managing intake, guided buying, sourcing, purchasing, invoicing, renewals, approvals, and procurement analytics.

product.name: LegalWorks
product.description: A legal operations orchestration solution that automates legal intake, triage, matter coordination, contract workflows, mailroom processing, and legal operations reporting.

product.name: Contracts Hub
product.description: An AI-enabled contract orchestration solution for coordinating contract requests, reviews, approvals, signatures, and post-signature obligations.
